title: fix(backup): reject malformed UTF-8 manifests before verification
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Backup verification certifies a readable archive whose manifest contains malformed UTF-8, reporting silently altered manifest metadata.

## User Impact

Reject a corrupted manifest before JSON/schema validation and archive certification. Preserve valid Unicode metadata and the existing archive safety and inventory checks.

No new option, default, permission, schema, protocol, migration or upgrade behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

Validate complete input bytes before lossy conversion, at the existing canonical reader. Preserve parsing, bounds, I/O cleanup and downstream writers. Any extraction moves the existing real production reader to satisfy the inherited line-cap growth rule; it adds no test-only seam.

## Evidence

- Scenario: Reject a corrupted manifest before JSON/schema validation and archive certification. Preserve valid Unicode metadata and the existing archive safety and inventory checks.; Valid byte input retains established behavior
- Entry: node "$CHECKOUT/openclaw.mjs" backup verify $PROOF_ROOT/invalid.tar.gz --json; disputed owner ran unmocked: The bounded unique-manifest extractor used by the actual backup verifier and restore preparation
- Same command on base `57dd17b` and head `ea745b7`: `node "$PROOF_HARNESS" "$CHECKOUT" "$PHASE"`
  - Before (base): RED: Malformed manifest exits0 and reports runtimeVersion fixture-� as a verified backup.
  - After (head): GREEN: Malformed manifest exits1 without certifying it; the archive hash stays identical. Legal archive exits0 and reports fixture-合法 � 😀 with assetCount1.
- Readback (disk): Read real backup verify --json results and independently hash each actual tar.gz archive before/after the command; positive control reads exact runtimeVersion and assetCount.
- Proof harness: Identical collector SHA256 20394f34f4b7dc932a00efa6dbb5256ed261d0a3e52ac5d8764d9af36ac4a20d; normally built CLI, real owner and boundary readback; exact input/commands/observations below
- Control: Malformed archive produces 0 successful verifications (real CLI exit1/ok:false); 1 legal gzip/tar archive exits0, reports assetCount1 and exact CJK/literal U+FFFD/emoji runtimeVersion. Both archive hashes remain byte-exact.
- Other callers checked: extractManifest → verifyResolvedBackupArchive → prepareBackupArchive/verifyBackupArchive; backup creation verification, restore preparation and update protection callers inspected. Existing tar/path/link/schema and modern SQLite inventory checks are unchanged.
- Tests: pnpm test src/commands/backup-verify.utf8.test.ts src/commands/backup-verify.test.ts --maxWorkers=1:75 passed,1 existing skip,86.99s; final changed-test rerun3 passed25.84s after removing a redundant synchronous await. Native line-cap/suppression guards, changed-file format/typed lint, production core and related native test type graph passed. (measured cost: Final changed-suite wrapper 25.84s. See actual commands/retained suite costs below; cold compiled-worker/type preparation dominates long full-file wrappers, not sleeps or per-case service boot.)
- Not tested: Live restore, uploaded remote archives, Windows, installed-release upgrades and a modern SQLite inventory archive were not tested. This legacy-format fixture has no database inventory and does not prove modern SQLite completeness; retained full verifier tests cover existing inventory logic.


<details>
<summary>Exact-head built-CLI input and independent readback</summary>

Product head SHA: `ea745b7d132a5312e19fc9c821350c57cdf8ab4d`; baseline SHA: `57dd17b4ea39b5f5d87db9faabaa2f0b10fa83f4`. Observed 2026-10-08T18:15:46.820Z; Linux, Node24.16.0, OpenClaw2026.9.9. Both phases use the normal `node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs scripts/build-all.mts qaRuntime` build and real `openclaw.mjs`. Candidate stamp matches its head and inputsClean=true. Unrelated workboard frontend hashes emitted by the build were restored to the tracked baseline; they are outside these byte readers and are not part of the patch.

Each phase owns fresh private HOME/config/state/agent/workspace/temp paths. No production Gateway, provider or channel is contacted. Owned loopback endpoints stay outside the changed reader.

Fixture: Owned gzip/tar includes ROOT/manifest.json and ROOT/payload/posix/tmp/.openclaw/payload.txt. Valid legacy schemaVersion1 manifest declares exactly that state asset, runtimeVersion fixture-SENTINEL, platform linux, Node version and fixed createdAt/archiveRoot. Replace SENTINEL with FF for malformed input; valid control uses fixture-合法 � 😀.

Actual candidate commands; baseline uses the same scenes and input construction:

```sh
node "$CHECKOUT/openclaw.mjs" backup verify "$PROOF_ROOT/invalid.tar.gz" --json # invalid: exit 1
node "$CHECKOUT/openclaw.mjs" backup verify "$PROOF_ROOT/legal.tar.gz" --json # legal: exit 0
```

Proper baseline regression failures precede production edits; legal controls pass. Native line-cap/suppression guards, changed-file format/typed lint, production core and relevant native test type graph passed. Full upstream required CI is pending PR creation; no global dead-export/full-repo test pass is claimed. Independent complete-candidate source review and publication preview are recorded before publication.

Scope: 2 files; production +4/-0; tests +62/-0. All existing sibling/downstream assertions retained.

Cleanup: CLI children and owned HTTP endpoints closed; isolated receipts retained outside the product branch. Live restore, uploaded remote archives, Windows, installed-release upgrades and a modern SQLite inventory archive were not tested. This legacy-format fixture has no database inventory and does not prove modern SQLite completeness; retained full verifier tests cover existing inventory logic.

</details>


## Maintainer CLI proof

On main `15305ccd53dedd1663a89f92a402480d7b71bbf8`, real `backup verify <archive> --json` certified manifests with byte FF and truncated E2 82 as `ok: true`, replacing runtime metadata with U+FFFD. The built exact candidate rejects both with `ok: false` and “Backup manifest must be valid UTF-8.” All archives remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Valid `合法 � 😀` metadata verifies successfully and is reported unchanged. This is read-only archive verification, not a backup write. Build and real `pnpm tsgo` passed in secretless Docker. The lane’s one live gpt-5-mini call completed successfully (reasoning low, output budget 4096).

No overlap with Pash/Sarah changes. Contributor credit: Alix-007.

Merge danger: two-way door. Blast radius: malformed UTF-8 backup manifests previously certified through lossy decoding.
